name: oxoxos-cocos-game-assets-mcp
description: Independent Cocos-oriented game asset MCP powered by OXOXOS: live model discovery, image generation, vision analysis, reference editing, and local sprite processing.

description_i18n.en: Independent Cocos-oriented game asset MCP powered by OXOXOS: live model discovery, image generation, vision analysis, reference editing, and local sprite processing.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 面向 Cocos Creator 与 AI 游戏开发的独立素材 MCP：接入 OXOXOS 动态模型广场，提供生图、识图、参考图编辑和本地精灵图处理。非 Cocos 官方项目。

api_key.title: OXOXOS API Token
api_key.description: Optional UI entry. The automated installer can securely store the token in the current user's private OXOXOS credential file instead.

image_model.title: Image model override
image_model.description: Optional model id. Leave empty to discover a current image model from the OXOXOS marketplace.

vision_model.title: Vision model override
vision_model.description: Optional model id. Leave empty to discover a current vision model from the OXOXOS marketplace.
